chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.name: chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign
chk_inventory_transactions_quantity_sign.value:
(type IN ('RECEIPT', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'PRODUCTION_IN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN') AND quantity > 0)
          OR (type IN ('ISSUE', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'PRODUCTION_OUT', 'ADJUSTMENT_OUT') AND quantity < 0)

chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range.name: chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range
chk_qc_aql_rules_lot_size_range.value: lot_size_max IS NULL OR lot_size_max >= lot_size_min

chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_pair.name: chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_pair
chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_pair.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR (sort_ok_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ok_qty >= 0 AND sort_ng_qty >= 0)

chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_requires_sort.name: chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_requires_sort
chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_requires_sort.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR disposition = 'SORT'

chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_total.name: chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_total
chk_qc_requests_sort_qty_total.value: sort_ok_qty IS NULL OR sort_ok_qty + sort_ng_qty = quantity

chk_qc_requests_source_exclusive.name: chk_qc_requests_source_exclusive
chk_qc_requests_source_exclusive.value: NOT (inventory_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND outsourcing_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_qc_requests_outsourcing_item.name: chk_qc_requests_outsourcing_item
chk_qc_requests_outsourcing_item.value: outsourcing_receipt_item_id IS NULL OR outsourcing_receipt_id IS NOT NULL

chk_qc_requests_incoming_supplier.name: chk_qc_requests_incoming_supplier
chk_qc_requests_incoming_supplier.value: kind <> 'INCOMING' OR supplier_id IS NOT NULL

chk_qc_requests_outgoing_no_incoming_fie.name: chk_qc_requests_outgoing_no_incoming_fields
chk_qc_requests_outgoing_no_incoming_fie.value:
kind <> 'OUTGOING' OR (
        reason IS NULL AND inspection_standard IS NULL AND inspector_name IS NULL
        AND measuring_tools IS NULL AND qc_department_id IS NULL
        AND sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL
      )

chk_qc_requests_outgoing_job.name: chk_qc_requests_outgoing_job
chk_qc_requests_outgoing_job.value: kind <> 'OUTGOING' OR (production_job_id IS NOT NULL AND production_job_operation_id IS NOT NULL)

chk_qc_requests_status_by_kind.name: chk_qc_requests_status_by_kind
chk_qc_requests_status_by_kind.value:
(kind = 'INCOMING' AND status IN ('NOT_INSPECTED','PENDING','WAITING_RETURN','COMPLETED'))
          OR (kind = 'OUTGOING' AND status IN ('NOT_INSPECTED','PENDING','REWORK','COMPLETED'))

chk_qc_requests_disposition_by_kind.name: chk_qc_requests_disposition_by_kind
chk_qc_requests_disposition_by_kind.value:
disposition IS NULL
          OR (kind = 'INCOMING' AND disposition IN ('CONCESSION','SORT','RETURN'))
          OR (kind = 'OUTGOING' AND disposition IN ('ACCEPT','REWORK','SCRAP'))

chk_qc_inspections_ac_re_order.name: chk_qc_inspections_ac_re_order
chk_qc_inspections_ac_re_order.value: acceptance_number IS NULL OR rejection_number > acceptance_number

chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_total.name: chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_total
chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_total.value: sort_ok_qty IS NULL OR sort_ok_qty + sort_ng_qty = quantity

chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_pair.name: chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_pair
chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_pair.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR (sort_ok_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NOT NULL AND sort_ok_qty >= 0 AND sort_ng_qty >= 0)

chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_sor.name: chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_sort
chk_qc_inspections_sort_qty_requires_sor.value: (sort_ok_qty IS NULL AND sort_ng_qty IS NULL) OR disposition = 'SORT'

chk_qc_inspections_disposition_by_kind.name: chk_qc_inspections_disposition_by_kind
chk_qc_inspections_disposition_by_kind.value:
disposition IS NULL
          OR (kind = 'INCOMING' AND disposition IN ('CONCESSION','SORT','RETURN'))
          OR (kind = 'OUTGOING' AND disposition IN ('ACCEPT','REWORK','SCRAP'))

chk_qc_inspections_resulting_status_by_k.name: chk_qc_inspections_resulting_status_by_kind
chk_qc_inspections_resulting_status_by_k.value:
(kind = 'INCOMING' AND resulting_status IN ('NOT_INSPECTED','PENDING','WAITING_RETURN','COMPLETED'))
          OR (kind = 'OUTGOING' AND resulting_status IN ('NOT_INSPECTED','PENDING','REWORK','COMPLETED'))

chk_production_orders_status_fields.name: chk_production_orders_status_fields
chk_production_orders_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND code IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'APPROVED' AND code IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_jobs_status_fields.name: chk_production_jobs_status_fields
chk_production_jobs_status_fields.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND started_at IS NULL)
          OR (status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND started_at IS NOT NULL)

chk_production_job_issues_qty.name: chk_production_job_issues_qty
chk_production_job_issues_qty.value: (unit_qty IS NULL OR unit_qty > 0) AND required_qty > 0
